name: Abdullah Obaidullah
headline: Founder & CEO | Salesforce Commerce Cloud Consultant
about:
With over 7.5 years in technology leadership, my core competencies lie in pioneering e-commerce solutions and steering business growth at ANTSOFT. I aim to leverage my expertise in Salesforce Commerce Cloud to deliver cutting-edge platforms that align with the organization's culture of innovation. I am committed to expanding our reach through strategic partnerships and new market exploration, consistently aiming to bring diverse perspectives and experiences to our team.

At ANTSOFT, my role as Founder and CEO encompasses setting the direction and executing the vision that has propelled our company forward. I thrive on identifying new business opportunities and have a proven track record in setting performance metrics that ensure we meet our ambitious goals. My hands-on experience with Salesforce B2C Commerce has been instrumental in delivering scalable and robust e-commerce solutions.
